# Construction, power, bills and doors

Four kits cover building: `game.build` (blueprints, frames, instant building), `game.power` (power nets and batteries), `game.bills` (workbench bills and recipes) and `game.doors` and `game.traps`. They are Experimental in the [stability tiers](stability.md). The older `game.buildings.power_on`, `set_power` and `flick` keep working.

`blueprint` plans a building and colonists build it, `instant` builds it at once. `can_place` tells you why a spot does not work.

```lua
local map = game.maps.current()
local c = game.things.info(colonist)

-- Plan a wall line
for dx = 1, 5 do
  local ok = game.build.can_place(map, "Wall", c.x + dx, c.z + 4, { stuff = "WoodLog" })
  if ok.ok then game.build.blueprint(map, "Wall", c.x + dx, c.z + 4, { stuff = "WoodLog" }) end
end

-- Queue 10 simple meals on every stove
for _, thing in ipairs(game.query.things({ map = map, def = "FueledStove" })) do
  game.bills.add(thing, "CookMealSimple", { mode = "RepeatCount", count = 10 })
end
```

## Functions

| Function | Parameters | Returns | Description |
|----------|------------|---------|-------------|
| `game.build.can_place` | `map, def, x, z, opts?` | `RimPlacement` | Whether a building can be planned there, and why not. |
| `game.build.blueprint` | `map, def, x, z, opts?` | `RimThing` | Plans a building. Colonists build it. |
| `game.build.blueprints` | `map` | `RimBuildSite[]` | Planned buildings. |
| `game.build.frames` | `map` | `RimBuildSite[]` | Buildings under construction with their progress. |
| `game.build.instant` | `map, def, x, z, opts?` | `RimThing` | Builds a finished building at once. |
| `game.build.cancel` | `thing` | `boolean` | Cancels a blueprint or frame. |
| `game.build.defs` | `category?` | `RimBuildableInfo[]` | Buildings a player can build, optionally one architect category. |
| `game.power.net` | `thing` | `RimPowerInfo` | Power state of a building and its whole power net. |
| `game.power.set_battery` | `thing, pct` | `number` | Sets a battery's charge from 0 to 1. |
| `game.bills.list` | `thing` | `RimBillInfo[]` | The bills on a workbench. |
| `game.bills.add` | `thing, recipe, opts?` | `integer` | Adds a bill. Returns its index. |
| `game.bills.remove` | `thing, index` | `boolean` | Deletes a bill by index. |
| `game.bills.suspend` | `thing, index, suspended` | `boolean` | Suspends or resumes a bill. |
| `game.bills.recipes` | `thing` | `RimRecipeInfo[]` | What a workbench can make. |
| `game.doors.info` | `thing` | `RimDoorInfo` | State of a door. |
| `game.doors.hold_open` | `thing, hold` | `boolean` | Holds a door open. |
| `game.traps.info` | `thing` | `{ armed: boolean, class: string }` | Whether a trap is armed. |
